## workflow worklog

Log work on a Jira issue

### Synopsis

Log work on a Jira issue: how long, in Jira's own form (2h, 30m, 1d 4h), with
--comment's note beside it. The worklog is printed and confirmed before it is
logged. A forge issue keeps no worklog, so its number is refused, as is a blank
duration, before anything is asked.

```
workflow worklog <issue> <duration> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  workflow worklog PROJ-7 2h --comment "pairing on the fix" --yes
```

### Options

```
      --comment string   a note to log beside the time
  -h, --help             help for worklog
  -y, --yes              go ahead without the confirmation
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -n, --dry-run    hold back every write to Jira, the forge, the messaging service, Taskwarrior, git and files, and say what it would have done
      --log FILE   append a one-line outline of each request (method, path, status, duration) to FILE, for a bug report
```
